lines.a_zombie_bit_me_its: A zombie bit me. It's nothing, right?
lines.i_got_bitten_last_night: I got bitten last night. It's just a scratch.
lines.a_zombie_got_me_on: A zombie got me on the arm. I'm trying not to think about it.
lines.i_think_i_was_bitten: I think I was bitten. I don't feel any different. Yet.

i_was_bitten_what_do.text: I was bitten! What do I do? What do I do?

a_zombie_bit_me_dont.text: A zombie bit me. Don't tell Mum.

lines.i_dont_feel_right_ever: I don't feel right. Ever since that bite.
lines.im_burning_up_i_think: I'm burning up. I think it's the bite.
lines.im_scared_i_think_its: I'm scared. I think it's spreading.

i_think_this_is_how.text: I think this is how it ends for me.

lines.you_dont_look_well_were: You don't look well. Were you bitten?
lines.youre_burning_up_was_it: You're burning up. Was it a zombie?
lines.your_skins_gone_a_bit: Your skin's gone a bit green.
lines.that_cough_sounds_bad_is: That cough sounds bad. Is it the bite?
